text:
Skip to content
RH Dental

RH Dental Care · Banani

A dental practice that does not feel like one.

Dental anxiety does not usually start in the chair. It starts earlier — in the room before it. Banani is a small, appointment-only suite on the seventh floor of B&B Empire: panelled walls, warm light, and a schedule built so that your slot is yours.

Call 01721-367622
Request a time on WhatsApp
Who this branch is for

For executives, expat and NRB patients — anyone buying privacy and time.

Seen on your schedule, in a room that is yours for the whole appointment. Appointments are spaced rather than stacked, so the clinician is not moving between chairs and you are not waiting between stages of your own treatment.

If your case needs the in-house lab, an orthodontist, or the wider specialist team, that work sits at our Banasree hospital — and we will tell you so rather than stretch it across visits here.

One appointment at a time — no shared chair time
3D CBCT imaging on site
Consultation room separate from the treatment room
Appointment-only — no walk-in queue
The rooms

Photographed as they are, on an ordinary working day. Panelled walls, oak joinery, a plant in the corner and light that comes from behind everything rather than down onto it.

Reception. The desk is lit from underneath and the shelving from behind — nothing in the suite is lit from directly overhead.
A quiet room off the corridor. Four chairs, a low table, a plant — closer to a sitting room than a waiting hall.
Consulting happens here, at a desk, before anyone reclines. Plans and costs are discussed in this room, not in the chair.
The treatment room. The dental chair sits in the same panelled, cove-lit space as the rest of the suite.
The team at Banani

Banani runs a morning and an evening session. Who you see depends on the time you book, so the list below is worth a look before you choose a slot.

Level 7, B&B Empire, Plot 116, Road 11, Banani, Dhaka 1213
Morning 9:00 am – 2:00 pm · Evening 4:30 pm – 10:00 pm, by appointment
About Banani →

CHIEF CONSULTANT, ORAL & DENTAL SURGEON

QUESTIONS, ANSWERED
Every question

These are the questions that arrive in our inbox most often, with the answers we'd give you on a 10-minute WhatsApp call.

01
Is the treatment actually safe? I've heard mixed things about medical tourism.
+

The risk in medical tourism is not the country — it's the clinic. We use the same Swiss and Swedish implants, the same Liechtenstein ceramics and the same B-class sterilisation as a private clinic in London. Our chief consultant is BMDC-certified with international training; our advisor holds the FDS RCPS from Glasgow. You're not getting a cheap copy; you're getting the same procedure at honest local rates.

02
How long do I need to stay?
+

It depends on the procedure. A single crown or veneer set: 3–5 days. A full smile makeover with veneers: 5–8 days. Implants with same-day temporary loading: 7–10 days; with delayed loading (the safer, slower path): one short visit for surgery, then a second 4–6 months later for the permanent crowns. We build the schedule around your calendar, not ours.

03
What if something goes wrong after I return home?
+

Every implant carries the manufacturer's warranty (5 years to lifetime, depending on brand) and we hold the documentation for you. If you have an issue, you contact us on WhatsApp; we coordinate with your local dentist, send your full digital file and X-rays, and — where the issue is on us — cover the repair work. Roughly 0.3% of our international files have required a return trip.

04
Can I claim this on my private health insurance?
+

Most policies that cover dental work overseas will accept our paperwork — itemised invoice, treatment records, prescription summary, and the practitioner's BMDC number. We've successfully filed with Bupa, Cigna Global, Allianz Care and AXA. Your coordinator will hand you the file your insurer needs before you board the return flight.

05
How and when do I pay?
+

Half on arrival, after the 3D scan confirms the plan; the rest on completion. We accept international card payments (Visa / Mastercard / Amex) in USD, GBP or EUR, and bank transfer in any major currency. No prepayment required to book — the WhatsApp consultation is free and non-binding.

06
Do I need a special visa for medical treatment?
+

For most Western passports: no. A standard tourist visa (e-visa or visa-on-arrival) covers a dental treatment trip up to 30 days. If your treatment runs longer or you'd like the formal protection, we'll issue a medical-visa invitation letter and brief you on the paperwork — processed in 3–5 working days through the Bangladeshi mission in your country.

07
Is it safe to travel while recovering from dental surgery?
+

For minor work — fillings, crowns, single extractions, basic implants — you can fly the day after with no restrictions. For complex surgical work (sinus lifts, bone grafts, multiple implants), we recommend a 3-day window before flying to allow swelling to peak and recede. We schedule major work earlier in your trip and lighter work toward the end specifically for this reason.

08
Will the doctors actually speak fluent English?
+

Yes. Bangladesh has one of the highest English proficiency rates in non-anglophone Asia, and our entire clinical and coordination team works in English by default. Our chief consultant has trained internationally and lectures in English; our advisor holds a Glasgow fellowship. No translation app, no awkward intermediation — you ask your question, you get a direct answer.

09
Can I bring a friend or family member?
+

Strongly encouraged. Our coordinators handle their travel arrangements alongside yours — same hotel, same driver, same restaurant bookings. A companion fee covers nothing clinical but everything logistical; budget about $40/day on top of your trip cost. They are welcome in the consultation room at any point you'd like them there.

10
What's the worst-case scenario you've actually seen?
+

An honest one: a patient who landed with a fractured temporary crown after a long flight. We saw her within two hours, milled a replacement that afternoon, and rebooked her connecting flight. She left on time. Most "worst cases" are logistics, not clinical — and we've designed the whole process around catching them before they catch you.

Every question

These are the questions that arrive in our inbox most often, with the answers we'd give you on a 10-minute WhatsApp call.

Is the treatment actually safe? I've heard mixed things about medical tourism.
+

The risk in medical tourism is not the country — it's the clinic. We use the same Swiss and Swedish implants, the same Liechtenstein ceramics and the same B-class sterilisation as a private clinic in London. Our chief consultant is BMDC-certified with international training; our advisor holds the FDS RCPS from Glasgow. You're not getting a cheap copy; you're getting the same procedure at honest local rates.

How long do I need to stay?
+

It depends on the procedure. A single crown or veneer set: 3–5 days. A full smile makeover with veneers: 5–8 days. Implants with same-day temporary loading: 7–10 days; with delayed loading (the safer, slower path): one short visit for surgery, then a second 4–6 months later for the permanent crowns. We build the schedule around your calendar, not ours.

What if something goes wrong after I return home?
+

Every implant carries the manufacturer's warranty (5 years to lifetime, depending on brand) and we hold the documentation for you. If you have an issue, you contact us on WhatsApp; we coordinate with your local dentist, send your full digital file and X-rays, and — where the issue is on us — cover the repair work. Roughly 0.3% of our international files have required a return trip.

Can I claim this on my private health insurance?
+

Most policies that cover dental work overseas will accept our paperwork — itemised invoice, treatment records, prescription summary, and the practitioner's BMDC number. We've successfully filed with Bupa, Cigna Global, Allianz Care and AXA. Your coordinator will hand you the file your insurer needs before you board the return flight.

How and when do I pay?
+

Half on arrival, after the 3D scan confirms the plan; the rest on completion. We accept international card payments (Visa / Mastercard / Amex) in USD, GBP or EUR, and bank transfer in any major currency. No prepayment required to book — the WhatsApp consultation is free and non-binding.

Do I need a special visa for medical treatment?
+

For most Western passports: no. A standard tourist visa (e-visa or visa-on-arrival) covers a dental treatment trip up to 30 days. If your treatment runs longer or you'd like the formal protection, we'll issue a medical-visa invitation letter and brief you on the paperwork — processed in 3–5 working days through the Bangladeshi mission in your country.

Is it safe to travel while recovering from dental surgery?
+

For minor work — fillings, crowns, single extractions, basic implants — you can fly the day after with no restrictions. For complex surgical work (sinus lifts, bone grafts, multiple implants), we recommend a 3-day window before flying to allow swelling to peak and recede. We schedule major work earlier in your trip and lighter work toward the end specifically for this reason.

Will the doctors actually speak fluent English?
+

Yes. Bangladesh has one of the highest English proficiency rates in non-anglophone Asia, and our entire clinical and coordination team works in English by default. Our chief consultant has trained internationally and lectures in English; our advisor holds a Glasgow fellowship. No translation app, no awkward intermediation — you ask your question, you get a direct answer.

Can I bring a friend or family member?
+

Strongly encouraged. Our coordinators handle their travel arrangements alongside yours — same hotel, same driver, same restaurant bookings. A companion fee covers nothing clinical but everything logistical; budget about $40/day on top of your trip cost. They are welcome in the consultation room at any point you'd like them there.

What's the worst-case scenario you've actually seen?
+

An honest one: a patient who landed with a fractured temporary crown after a long flight. We saw her within two hours, milled a replacement that afternoon, and rebooked her connecting flight. She left on time. Most "worst cases" are logistics, not clinical — and we've designed the whole process around catching them before they catch you.

COMMON QUESTIONS
Implant FAQ

Answers to the most frequently asked questions about dental implants.

Is dental implant surgery painful?

The procedure is performed under local anaesthetic, so you should not feel the surgery itself. Most patients report mild discomfort for 2-3 days afterwards, usually manageable with the medication prescribed.

How long does a dental implant last?

With proper oral hygiene and regular check-ups, dental implants can last a lifetime. The crown may need replacement after 10-15 years due to normal wear.

Am I a good candidate for implants?

Most adults with good general health are candidates. Adequate jawbone density is needed, but bone grafting can address bone loss. A consultation will confirm your eligibility.

How is the implant position planned?

From a 3D CBCT scan taken before surgery, so bone height, bone width and the position of the nerve and sinus are measured rather than estimated from a flat X-ray.

Can I get teeth in one day?

Yes! We offer immediate loading implants where you receive a temporary prosthesis on the same day as surgery. The permanent crown is placed after osseointegration.

How much does a dental implant cost?

We offer three specialized packages: Osstem SA (৳45,000), Osstem SOI (৳60,000), and Nobel Biocare (৳80,000). Prices include the implant fixture, surgical placement, and final prosthesis.

How long does a dental implant take from start to finished tooth?

For a straightforward single implant, most cases run three to six months from placement to the final crown, because the implant needs time to integrate with bone before it can carry a load. The surgery itself is usually a single appointment of about an hour. Cases needing a bone graft or a sinus lift add healing time before placement.

Is implant surgery planned from a CBCT scan?

Yes. A 3D CBCT scan is taken before placement so bone height, bone width and the position of the inferior alveolar nerve and the maxillary sinus are measured rather than estimated from a flat X-ray. The scan is also what makes a guided surgical stent possible, so the implant goes where it was planned to go.

Which implant system do you use?

Osstem, a South Korean implant system, is used for our standard implant package — the fixture named on the pricing section of this page is the Osstem SA.

Is the crown made in-house?

At the Banasree branch, yes — the in-house master digital lab mills and finishes crowns and bridges on site, which removes the courier round-trip to an outside lab and shortens the wait between fitting appointments. Intraoral scanning replaces the impression tray for most cases.

Which branch should I go to for an implant?

Either — the surgery, the systems and the clinicians are the same at both. Choose Banasree if you want the published price list, the in-house lab and 0% EMI on a multi-visit plan. Choose Banani if you want an appointment-only slot with the room to yourself and CBCT read in the same visit.

COMMON QUESTIONS
Implant FAQ

Answers to the most frequently asked questions about dental implants.

Is dental implant surgery painful?

The procedure is performed under local anaesthetic, so you should not feel the surgery itself. Most patients report mild discomfort for 2-3 days afterwards, usually manageable with the medication prescribed.

How long does a dental implant last?

With proper oral hygiene and regular check-ups, dental implants can last a lifetime. The crown may need replacement after 10-15 years due to normal wear.

Am I a good candidate for implants?

Most adults with good general health are candidates. Adequate jawbone density is needed, but bone grafting can address bone loss. A consultation will confirm your eligibility.

How is the implant position planned?

From a 3D CBCT scan taken before surgery, so bone height, bone width and the position of the nerve and sinus are measured rather than estimated from a flat X-ray.

Can I get teeth in one day?

Yes! We offer immediate loading implants where you receive a temporary prosthesis on the same day as surgery. The permanent crown is placed after osseointegration.

How much does a dental implant cost?

We offer three specialized packages: Osstem SA (৳45,000), Osstem SOI (৳60,000), and Nobel Biocare (৳80,000). Prices include the implant fixture, surgical placement, and final prosthesis.

How long does a dental implant take from start to finished tooth?

For a straightforward single implant, most cases run three to six months from placement to the final crown, because the implant needs time to integrate with bone before it can carry a load. The surgery itself is usually a single appointment of about an hour. Cases needing a bone graft or a sinus lift add healing time before placement.

Is implant surgery planned from a CBCT scan?

Yes. A 3D CBCT scan is taken before placement so bone height, bone width and the position of the inferior alveolar nerve and the maxillary sinus are measured rather than estimated from a flat X-ray. The scan is also what makes a guided surgical stent possible, so the implant goes where it was planned to go.

Which implant system do you use?

Osstem, a South Korean implant system, is used for our standard implant package — the fixture named on the pricing section of this page is the Osstem SA.

Is the crown made in-house?

At the Banasree branch, yes — the in-house master digital lab mills and finishes crowns and bridges on site, which removes the courier round-trip to an outside lab and shortens the wait between fitting appointments. Intraoral scanning replaces the impression tray for most cases.

Which branch should I go to for an implant?

Either — the surgery, the systems and the clinicians are the same at both. Choose Banasree if you want the published price list, the in-house lab and 0% EMI on a multi-visit plan. Choose Banani if you want an appointment-only slot with the room to yourself and CBCT read in the same visit.

Instant, high-resolution imaging with minimal radiation exposure, allowing real-time evaluation and monitoring throughout the procedure.

Post-Endodontic Crown

Restores strength, function, and long-term durability of the treated tooth.

Digital Follow-Up

Ideal for vital teeth, early-stage infections, and patients without severe swelling or active abscess. For more complex conditions, a multi-visit approach may be recommended for optimal healing.

IN-HOUSE CAD/CAM DENTAL LABORATORY
Precision. Strength. Natural Beauty.

At RH Dental Care, we combine advanced digital dentistry, premium zirconia materials, expert crown designing, and strict quality control to create restorations that are designed for both long-lasting function and a natural-looking smile.

Your crown is not simply ordered from an outside laboratory. We have our own in-house CAD/CAM laboratory, allowing us to maintain closer control over the entire process, from digital design and milling to finishing and final quality checking.

Better precision
Consistency
Clearer communication
Faster turnaround
WHY RH DENTAL CARE
Why Choose Our Zirconia Crowns?

Premium dentistry is not only about premium materials. It is about maintaining quality at every step.

In-House CAD/CAM Dental Laboratory

Your crown is not simply ordered from an outside laboratory. Design, milling, finishing and final checks all happen in our own lab.

Premium Zirconia Materials

High-quality zirconia discs such as Upcera, Xtcera and multilayer aesthetic zirconia, selected for each clinical case.

Expert Crown Designing

Designs developed and reviewed by experienced local and international dental CAD/design experts, depending on case complexity.

Digital Precision

Scanning, CAD design, CAM milling and professional finishing in one integrated digital workflow for greater consistency.

Strict Quality Control

Every case goes through multiple stages of checking by our clinical and laboratory teams before delivery.

We Stand Behind Our Work

If a crown from our lab develops a manufacturing-related problem covered by our service policy, we assess it and, when appropriate, replace it.

PREMIUM ZIRCONIA MATERIALS
The Right Zirconia for Your Tooth

We carefully select high-quality zirconia discs for our restorations, including premium materials such as:

Upcera Zirconia
Xtcera Zirconia
Multilayer / highly aesthetic zirconia options
Material selection according to the individual clinical requirement

The right zirconia is selected based on tooth position, functional load, aesthetic requirements, occlusion, and available space.

EXPERT CROWN DESIGNING
A Beautiful Crown Starts with Design

Our crown designs can be developed and reviewed by experienced local and international dental CAD/design experts, depending on the complexity and aesthetic requirements of the case. We focus on:

Natural tooth shape
Proper proportions
Smile-line harmony
Contact points
Occlusion and bite
Marginal adaptation
Functional anatomy
Shade and translucency
Facial and smile aesthetics
STRICT QUALITY CONTROL
Checked at Every Step

Before a zirconia crown is delivered, our clinical and laboratory teams check each stage and make the necessary adjustments before it is permanently cemented.

Design
Fit
Margins
Contacts
Occlusion
Shape
Shade
Surface Finish
Final Polish
What If There Is a Problem?

We stand behind the quality of our work. If a crown manufactured by our laboratory develops a manufacturing-related problem covered under our service policy, we will assess the case and, when appropriate, replace the crown rather than simply asking you to accept the problem. You should be confident about the restoration you receive.

SUITABLE FOR
When Zirconia Crowns Are Recommended
Damaged or heavily restored teeth
Root-canal-treated teeth requiring full coverage
Fractured teeth
Discolored teeth
Replacement of old crowns
Dental bridges
Implant-supported crowns
Full-mouth rehabilitation
Smile makeover cases

The most suitable restoration depends on your individual clinical condition.

NATURAL-LOOKING SMILE
Strong and Natural

Modern zirconia is no longer limited to strong but opaque-looking crowns. With appropriate material selection, digital design, characterization and finishing, zirconia can provide an excellent combination of:

Strength
Aesthetics
Function
Biocompatibility

For highly aesthetic cases, our dental team carefully considers your facial features, existing teeth, smile line and desired appearance before finalizing the design.

Price

Zirconia crown treatment starts at ৳20,000, including the digital workflow, scanning and crown placement.

DIGITAL WORKFLOW
Our Zirconia Crown Workflow

Scanning, CAD design, CAM milling and professional finishing, integrated in one digital workflow.

01
Clinical Assessment

Our dentist examines your teeth, gums, bite and overall oral condition.

02
Digital Scan

Digital impressions/scans are taken whenever clinically appropriate.

03
Digital Smile & Crown Design

The crown is digitally designed according to your tooth anatomy, occlusion and aesthetic requirements.

04
Expert Review

Complex or highly aesthetic cases may be reviewed by experienced CAD/design professionals.

05
CAD/CAM Milling

The approved design is milled from selected premium zirconia material in our in-house laboratory.

06
Finishing & Characterization

The restoration is professionally finished, polished and characterized to achieve the desired appearance.

07
Clinical Try-In

Fit, contacts, margins, shade and occlusion are carefully evaluated.

08
Final Cementation

After all necessary checks and adjustments, the crown is permanently cemented.

More Than a Crown

At RH Dental Care, we don’t believe in simply placing a crown and calling the treatment complete. We focus on the entire restorative process, from diagnosis and treatment planning to digital design, laboratory fabrication, clinical fitting and long-term follow-up.

RH DENTAL CARE
Your Tooth. Your Smile. Our Responsibility.

What Are Indirect Zirconia Veneers?

Indirect zirconia veneers are ultra-thin customized ceramic shells made from premium zirconia material that are bonded to the front surface of teeth to improve appearance and smile aesthetics.

Unlike direct composite veneers, these veneers are digitally designed and fabricated outside the mouth using advanced CAD/CAM technology, ensuring superior precision, strength, and natural beauty.

At RH Dental Care, every veneer is individually crafted according to the patient’s facial profile, smile line, lip support, and tooth anatomy to achieve the most natural and elegant result possible.

WHY CHOOSE ZIRCONIA VENEERS?
Precision, Strength, and Elegance

Discover the outstanding benefits of modern zirconia veneers over conventional cosmetic options.

Exceptional Natural Appearance

Modern zirconia veneers mimic the translucency and shine of natural teeth, creating a highly aesthetic and realistic smile.

Strong & Durable

Zirconia is one of the strongest dental ceramics, highly resistant to fracture, wear, and discoloration for long-term smile rehabilitation.

Stain Resistant

Resists staining from tea, coffee, smoking, and colored foods, helping maintain a bright smile for years.

Minimal Tooth Reduction

Our minimally invasive technique preserves maximum natural tooth structure while delivering outstanding cosmetic improvement.

Digitally Customized Smile

Using advanced 3D scanning technology, we create highly accurate designs tailored specifically to your facial aesthetics.

TREATMENT INDICATIONS
Conditions That Can Be Corrected

Indirect zirconia veneers can dramatically improve a wide variety of cosmetic dental issues to give you a flawless smile.

Discolored or stained teeth
Chipped or fractured teeth
Uneven or irregular teeth
Gaps between teeth
Mildly crowded or misaligned teeth
Worn down teeth
Old unaesthetic restorations
Smile asymmetry
Smile with Confidence

A beautiful smile can improve confidence, personality, and overall appearance. Our goal is to create confident, healthy, and attractive smiles through modern digital dentistry.
